subject: OrchardTech private onboarding & network agreement
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@orchardtech.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: networking@orchardtech.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Private deployment kickoff (VPC peering / on-prem)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — OrchardTech is excited to move forward with a private deployment for the fraud-detection pipeline. Our security and infra teams have a few mandatory constraints (VPC peering + private endpoints, HSM/KMS proximity, and an option to accept an on-prem appliance if needed).

High level asks to get a technical kickoff scheduled:
- Confirm Redwood’s requirements for VPC peering (CIDR / routes / peering vs. VPN).
- Network ACLs / firewall ports needed for control plane + agent telemetry.
- Options and lead time for the on-prem package (if we go that route).
- Evidence we can share with our auditors (SOC2 summary / network diagram).

I’ve CC’d our networking mailbox. Can we schedule a 60-minute technical call next week (Mon-Tue pref)? We’d like to include our security lead and cloud infra engineer.

Thanks,
Alex Porter
Head of Platform
OrchardTech

[Attachment: orchard_vpc-diagram.png (image/png)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@orchardtech.com>
Cc: networking@orchardtech.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Private deployment kickoff (VPC peering / on-prem)

Hi Alex — great to hear and congrats on the decision to go private. I’ve looped in Marissa from our Delivery team so she can help coordinate the implementation runbook.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical kickoff (60m): we can do Monday 5/17 at 10:00am PT or Tuesday 5/18 at 9:00am PT. Please confirm which works and who from your side will join.
2) I’ve attached our network prerequisites doc for OrchardTech to review (short checklist with CIDR guidance, port list, and TLS requirements).
3) If on-prem is required, we’ll include Ben from Hardware/Appliance delivery in the follow-up.

Quick answers to your initial asks:
- VPC peering: we support AWS VPC peering and AWS PrivateLink for control plane traffic. Preferred approach is peering for lower latency; we provide expected CIDRs and NAT details in the attached.
- Ports: 443 (control plane), 50051 (gRPC for agent telemetry), 12345 (optional health/probe port) plus ephemeral outbound for model pulls.
- On-prem lead time: nominally 6–8 weeks for appliance provisioning + image signing; we’ll confirm with Ben once scope is final.
- Audit evidence: we can provide our SOC 2 summary + network diagram and a short checklist of what logs we expose.

Attaching: redwood-network-prereqs.pdf

—
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-network-prereqs.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@orchardtech.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: networking@orchardtech.com, Morgan Green <morgan@netbridge.io>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Private deployment kickoff (VPC peering / on-prem)

Chloe, thanks — Monday 5/17 at 10:00am PT works for us. Attendees: me, Priya Rao (cloud infra), Daniel Kim (security), and Morgan (our external network consultant).

A few additional details to help your prep team:
- Our primary VPC CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16 (we can allocate a /24 for peering endpoints if needed).
- We will require that control-plane calls originate from specific egress IPs; Daniel will share a short list during the call.
- We currently use AWS KMS (regional) and would prefer proximity to KMS for key wrapping; we’re open to HSM integration if required for compliance.

Attaching the internal VPC diagram and a quick firewall policy export. We’d like Redwood to review and call out any hotspots or non-standard ports before the kickoff so the call can be execution-focused.

Thanks — look forward to the meeting.
Alex

[Attachment: orchard_vpc-diagram.png (image/png)]
[Attachment: orchard-firewall-extract.csv (text/csv)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@orchardtech.com>, networking@orchardtech.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intro + Private deployment kickoff (OrchardTech) — action: handoff / runbook owners

Folks — forwarding OrchardTech’s note and attachments. They requested a focused technical kickoff Mon 5/17 10am PT; Alex listed Priya (cloud infra) and Daniel (security) as primary engineers.

Please own the implementation artifacts below and confirm leads + a prep checklist by EOD Monday 5/16 so we can send the final agenda to OrchardTech before the call. Specific asks:
- Marissa: lead overall implementation cadence and mutual action plan; please prepare a short MAA draft.
- Ben: confirm appliance lead time estimates and network endpoints for on-prem option.
- Laura: review the firewall CSV and identify any non-standard ports or proxy concerns; provide a short note on our TLS/KMS requirements.

I’ve attached their VPC diagram and our prereqs. I’ll run the kickoff agenda once you confirm owners.

Thanks — Chloe

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai, Alex Porter <alex.porter@orchardtech.com>, networking@orchardtech.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro + Private deployment kickoff (OrchardTech) — action: handoff / runbook owners

Thanks Chloe — taking point on appliance/runbook items. Quick status and requests before Monday’s call:

Plan (internal):
- I will draft a minimal Mutual Action Plan (MAA) and attach an initial spreadsheet for review. Target: circulate draft by EOD 5/16.
- Dev->Ops handoff: we’ll need the exact egress IPs you mentioned (Daniel) so we can lock down the control-plane allowlist.
- Appliance timeline: baseline 6 weeks from signed MAA + scoping; we can shorten to 4 weeks if OrchardTech accepts a pre-signed image and week-to-week provisioning windows.

Open items for OrchardTech (please reply):
1) Confirm whether you prefer VPC peering (low-latency) or an AWS PrivateLink endpoint for control-plane traffic. If peering, please reserve a /28 for the peering endpoint.
2) Confirm KMS/HSM requirement: do you need a validated HSM (FIPS 140-2) at deploy time or is KMS regional key wrapping sufficient for now?
3) Please provide the list of egress IPs for our allowlist before the call.

I’ll attach the draft mutual_action_plan.xlsx to today’s note. Marissa — once I share the draft, can you finalize milestones and signature owners? Laura — flag anything urgent from the firewall export and I’ll incorporate allowances into the appliance image.

Ben Carter
Appliance Delivery Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
